nina (finance): Quick announce: rolling out a small billing buffer for hosted free-tier customers to reduce noisy tickets. Details in internal doc: https://redwood.internal/docs/billing/buffer (internal)

deploy-bot: Broadcast scheduled: 2026-04-05T18:00:00Z to Hosted free-tier customers. Template: billing/buffer-notice-v1

raj (billing): TL;DR: new $4 soft buffer applied to monthly usage. If a customer's overage is <= $4 at invoice time, we hold the charge for 7 days; if activity resumes we apply as account credit, otherwise it invoices normally. Applies to Hosted only, not Dedicated/reserved.

elsa (support): Can we get canned replies? Customers already ask "why didn't I get charged" and "why now".
nina (finance): Yes. Support playbook coming today in #support-playbooks. It will include sample responses and refund/escalation guidance.

raj (billing): Implementation notes for eng: add invoice flag "soft_buffer_applied" and string field "buffer_expiry_iso". No change to rate-limit headers. Feature flag: billing.soft_buffer.enabled

deploy-bot: Rollout plan: internal docs + playbook 2026-04-05 -> feature flag on 2026-04-06 -> monitor 14 days -> evaluate.

elsa (support): Thanks. Heads-up: we'll triage support tickets for any unexpected billing impacts during monitor window.
nina (finance): Thanks team. External FAQ will go out with the broadcast. :sparkles:
